professionalSummary: Three years as an Analytics Engineer on a consumer software company’s marketing data warehouse, responsible for building and maintaining 90+ transformation models under the established modelling framework. Experienced in reviewing analyst contributions, mentoring new analysts, running daily data quality checks, coordinating model releases, and documenting model limitations and hand‑over conditions.
experienceHighlights: Built and maintained 90+ transformation models, each submitted via a merge request in my name (src_c8b13508babc).
Reviewed analyst model contributions as one of two reviewers and mentored 11 analysts through onboarding sessions, with records in the repository (src_b261c59acb1c).
Ran daily data quality checks and resolved failures per procedure, logging each resolution (src_0b007064a027).
Coordinated model releases using a release checklist, with lead approval recorded (src_e27a725f38cf).
Authored limitation notes and hand‑over conditions for each model in its documentation page (src_fa7731420c61).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample includes two merge requests with review records, onboarding attendance log, one week of data quality failure log, and a release checklist with approval, all referenced in the repository (src_0edab3fe6eb7).

evidence.text: Analytics engineer on the marketing data warehouse of a consumer software company for three years, building and maintaining the warehouse's transformation models under the modelling framework's standard; about ninety models in the period, each on a merge request in my name.

Reviewed the marketing analysts' model contributions as one of the team's two reviewers and mentored the analysts new to the framework through the onboarding sessions; the review records and the onboarding attendance for eleven analysts are in the repository, with the analysts' first merged contributions logged against their onboarding.
Ran the data quality checks each day and resolved their failures under the data quality procedure, with the failure log recording each resolution.
Coordinated model releases through the release checklist; the release approval was the analytics engineering lead's, recorded on the checklist together with which checks were mine.
Wrote the limitation note and the hand-over conditions of each model in its documentation page.
